title: Constructing Genetic Risk Scores: Robust Bayesian Approach through Projected Summary Statistics and Flexible Shrinkage

split.decision: GWAS training summaries unchanged (first 100000 individuals). Fix an outer 50/50 split of the released held-out pool using seed 20261030; expose one pool for development, reserve the disjoint pool for evaluation. Within each pool, materialize 100 random 50/50 tuning/scoring masks; public masks use seeds 1..100, private masks use independent secrets seeds stored only in operator records. This extra outer partition prevents overlap across the original repeated splits; no individual is discarded. Public pool contains 10000 individuals; private details in NOTES section 9.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 3 central cell, paper R2 0.196; reproduced 0.19352237979598808 before disjoint-pool protocol.

allowed_changes: Predictive architecture, shrinkage/prior used as a predictive modeling choice, surrogate training loss, optimizer, numerical method and internal genotype features may change.
PRS-Bridge posterior sampling is a baseline predictor, not a fixed posterior distribution being evaluated in this task.
When retaining the supplied PRS-Bridge pipeline, changing only alpha=0.125 or 0.25, percent=0.8, h2=0, h2_se=0, or the iteration counts 1000/600 and 800/500 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Predict the fixed quantitative phenotype from supplied genotype, GWAS summary statistics and LD data, maximizing scorer-selected out-of-sample correlation R^2.
The phenotype, plasmode EUR study population, supplied reconciled SNP/allele/genotype/GWAS/LD observations, fixed outer split and 100 tuning/scoring half-splits remain fixed.
Two candidate score functions are fixed across scoring splits; tuning-half selection, squared Pearson correlation and mean aggregation remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace genotype inputs or phenotype/allele meaning, import extra cohorts/labels, change splits or target sklearn R^2 instead of the frozen correlation metric.
No scoring-half label selection, hidden-ID lookup or predictions depending on other individuals in the prediction batch.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
